headline: Discovery Call Framework & Execution Tracker ready for 5-customer pilot validation (Vanta, Linear, Census, Hex, Mercury)
highlights: 11-question structured discovery guide (45–60 min per call) with Van Westendorp WTP anchors ($2K–$36K)
Pre-call checklist, real-time scoring template, and post-call synthesis framework for consistent data capture
Aggregate metrics dashboard to track NPS, brand-fidelity, pricing acceptance, and conversion intent across cohort
Top 3 product requests ranking system with frequency counting across all 5 customers
Risk flag detection (pricing objections, product gaps, team adoption) with severity classification
Production-ready synthesis report template (≥1200 words) grounded in real customer voice and verbatim quotes
Individual customer brief template for 1-page intent classification, objections, and conversion path
Quality gate checklist ensuring all 5 calls documented with recordings, transcripts, and verified contact data
